title: Only 70 Right Whale Mothers Carry The Comeback
hook: A celebrated whale recovery rests on an alarmingly small group of mothers.
closing: Protecting breeding females is the narrowest path from a fragile rebound to recovery.
question: Can right whales recover?

segments.say: The right whale population reached 384. That rebound is real but still dangerously small.
The latest season produced 22 calves. Every birth depends on the species' limited mothers.
Only 70 right whales are breeding females. Losing even a few can stall the entire comeback.
